main_claim: Kriged distortion correction after ICP cuts Z error from bias +4.18 m / RMSE 4.53 m (initial) to bias -0.02 m / RMSE 0.21 m at 20 independent check points (factor-of-six RMSE reduction after ICP convergence); zero-change surfaces show mean 10.99 cm / SD 21.64 cm; the kriged surface is smooth low-frequency and removes global alignment error without smoothing localised features

main_claim: VCI detects 75.25% of overstory trees at precision 0.8172 / F1 0.7835 (0.5 m pixel; 1 m height bins; threshold 0.4); re-tuning one threshold (0.4 to 0.8) on UAV-LiDAR lifts F1 to 0.86 with recall 0.89 / precision 0.82; 21 of 34 apparent FPs were unlabelled true positives; runs in ~30 s per dataset on a 16 GB laptop
